messages:
sam_sales: Quick heads-up — POC kicked off with Acme Health. They want a private deployment in their VPC with tool-calling (calendar lookup + claims fetch) and semantic search (embeddings + reranker). Need success criteria, timeline, and security checklist answers by EOD Thursday. Can SE/legal help?

anya_se: On it. A few quick clarifying Qs: expected avg/session tokens and peak tokens? max context length they need? Do they require chain-of-thought traces in outputs? Also need sample prompts and whether they have a model-family preference (e.g., Redwood-7B / open-13B).

devon_pm: From their PM: target max context ~32k, typical convo size ~1.5k tokens. Primary use cases = chat assistant for claims triage + doc QA over ~1M docs. QPS initially low (5–10) but could spike to ~50. POC timeline they requested = ~6 weeks, then a pilot.

lucas_security: Flagging security items: private deployment requires customer KMS integration + immutable audit logs. For tool-calling we need operation-level consent and least-privilege IAM for the call agents. Please send the security questionnaire — I will fill and surface blockers. Also confirm whether they need HSM-backed keys.

sam_sales: Uploading their security questionnaire: https://acme.co/sec-q-2025.pdf — quick scan: asks specifically about data residency, encryption at rest/in-transit, deletion policy, and logs retention.

anya_se: Draft POC success criteria (proposal):
1) 95th perc response latency < 800ms for responses up to ~1k tokens under the baseline load.
2) Semantic search MAP@10 >= 0.65 on held-out evals (we'll run a 300-query eval).
3) Tool-calling intent->tool routing accuracy >= 92% on a 200-prompt test set.
4) No PII leakage incidents in synthetic prompt tests.
5) Cost target: expected serving cost <= $X per 1k tokens (we'll refine once we size GPUs).
Thoughts?

devon_pm: Looks good — add: ability to rotate keys without downtime, and a short SLO for availability (e.g., 99.9% during POC). I'll provide the 300 prompts and a 50k-doc subset for evals. Also want an A/B compare between quantized and fp16 models for reranker quality + cost.

anya_se: Perfect. For model fit I propose we benchmark two variants: Redwood-7B-QLo (fast, quantized) and OpenChain-13B-32k (higher quality for long-context QA). We'll test embeddings from both for reranking. Note: tool-calling will use typed function schemas — need to map their calendar + claims APIs to functions. Example function signature we expect:```
function fetch_claim(claim_id: string) -> {status: string, summary: string, last_updated: string}
```

sam_sales: They require typed function calls and streaming for long-doc answers (so partial outputs are helpful). Also asked about our recommended retry/fallback behavior if the tool fails.

lucas_security: Streaming is allowed but must not persist intermediate logs. We'll enforce redaction rules on logs and only store minimal telemetry. For keys they will host in GCP KMS — we support that (customer-managed keys). HSM: can support via partner integration; I'll confirm procurement timeline.

ci_bot: Deployment note: staging cluster created in us-west2-private-vpc-3. Runbook: /runbooks/poc-acme.md. CI hooks for evals staged.

anya_se: Action items: sam — send final completed questionnaire; devon — drop eval prompts + doc subset in the shared drive; lucas — fill security answers and confirm KMS/HSM detail; anya — I'll size GPUs, run initial benchmarks, and draft SOW + POC plan including success criteria and gating.

sam_sales: :thumbsup: I will send everything by 5pm PT today. Schedule quick sync Friday 10am PT to sign off on success criteria and cost estimates.
